raw_text: EXCLUSIVE FOOTAGE: Indian special forces conducting cross-border surgical strike! Watch our brave commandos in action! This video was captured during a covert operation across the LoC! The courage and skill of our soldiers is unmatched! Share this to show the world India's military power!
clean_text: Account shares video claiming Indian special forces surgical strike footage. Claims covert cross-border operation. Video is actually from a Bollywood war film.
